successors.text: the Bourbon army 'retook full control of the island on 15 May 1849 by force'

ledger.x: 12 January 1848: Palermo rises against the Bourbons and the Provisional Government founds the self-proclaimed Kingdom of Sicily.
1848: the revolution holds the island except Messina.
15 May 1849: the Bourbon army retakes Sicily.
15 May 1849: the Sicilian kingdom ends and the island returns to the Two Sicilies.

wars.name: Sicilian revolution of 1848
wars.outcome: The Bourbon army retook the island by force on 15 May 1849; the page's infobox result is 'Revolution suppressed; more powers to the Sicilian local administration' (rebel strength c.

certainty.note: An island: the coast is the frontier, but the revolution's hold on the Messina corner was never settled (the page says Parliament was never able to control it), so the north-east edge is soft.
